text: This is our pretend kindness garden. Caring choices help flowers grow. Unhelpful choices make flowers fade. We can always try a caring choice. Let's explore together!
Let's try the other choice. We can practice kindness.
We did it together! You can play again or choose all done.
You and a friend both want the playground shovel. Which choice helps?
Ask for a turn
Asking for a turn lets both friends have time to play. Our pretend garden grows!
Grab the shovel
Grabbing takes the shovel from your friend. Try asking for a turn.
Your friend wants a crayon from the shared box. Which choice helps?
Offer a crayon
Offering a crayon helps your friend join the drawing. Our pretend garden grows!
Hide all the crayons
Hiding all the crayons keeps your friend from drawing. Try offering one.
A friend is having a turn on the slide. Which choice helps?
Wait for my turn
Waiting gives your friend space to finish their turn. Our pretend garden grows!
Push past my friend
Pushing can hurt someone. Give your friend space and wait for your turn.
Your friend is ready to play catch with you. Which choice helps?
Pass the ball gently
A gentle pass shares the fun with your friend. Our pretend garden grows!
Keep every turn
Keeping every turn leaves your friend waiting. Try sharing a turn.
You and a friend are making a puzzle. Which choice helps?
Offer a puzzle piece
Offering a piece helps you build the puzzle together. Our pretend garden grows!
Scatter the pieces
Scattering the pieces makes the puzzle harder for your friend. Try offering a piece.
Playtime is finished and blocks cover the floor. Which choice helps?
Help put blocks away
Helping tidy makes a clear space for everyone. Our pretend garden grows!
Kick blocks around
Kicking the blocks spreads them around. Try placing them in the basket.
Some water spilled beside the table. Which choice helps?
Tell my grown-up
Telling your grown-up helps them make the floor safe and dry. Our pretend garden grows!
Splash it farther
Splashing spreads the water. Let your grown-up know about the spill.
The picture books are on the floor after story time. Which choice helps?
Put books on the shelf
Putting books away helps everyone find them next time. Our pretend garden grows!
Tear a book page
Tearing a page damages the book. Try handling the pages gently.
Your friend shows you a drawing they made. Which choice helps?
Say thanks for showing me
Thanking your friend welcomes what they wanted to share. Our pretend garden grows!
Scribble on their drawing
Scribbling on someone else's drawing can upset them. Ask before adding marks.
Your friend is carefully building a block tower. Which choice helps?
Ask if I can help
Asking gives your friend a choice about building together. Our pretend garden grows!
Knock their tower down
Knocking the tower down ruins your friend's work. Ask before joining their game.
A friend asks to join your pretend picnic. There is room. Which choice helps?
Make a place for them
Making a place welcomes your friend into the picnic. Our pretend garden grows!
Laugh and shut them out
Laughing at your friend can hurt their feelings. Try welcoming them kindly.
Your grown-up helps you find your missing shoe. Which choice helps?
Say or sign thank you
Saying or signing thank you shows you noticed their help. Our pretend garden grows!
Throw the shoe at them
Throwing a shoe can hurt someone. Try thanking them for helping.
Your friend says they do not want a hug. Which choice helps?
Offer a friendly wave
A wave respects your friend's choice. Hugs are always a choice. Our pretend garden grows!
Hug them anyway
Hugging after someone says no ignores their choice. Try a friendly wave instead.
Your friend asks for a little quiet space. Which choice helps?
Give them some space
Giving space listens to what your friend needs. Our pretend garden grows!
Shout beside their ear
Shouting beside their ear can feel uncomfortable. Try giving them quiet space.
You finished your turn with a shared toy truck. Your friend is waiting. Which choice helps?
Offer the next turn
Offering the next turn lets your friend enjoy the truck too. Our pretend garden grows!
Hide the shared truck
Hiding the shared truck keeps your friend from their turn. Try passing it over.
You accidentally bump your friend's arm. Which choice helps?
Ask if they are okay
Checking on your friend shows you care. A grown-up can help if needed. Our pretend garden grows!
Bump them again
Bumping again could hurt. Pause and check how your friend feels.
A grown-up says you may gently pet the cat. Which choice helps?
Use gentle hands
Gentle hands help care for the cat. Listen to your grown-up and give the cat space if it moves away. Our pretend garden grows!
Pull the cat's tail
Pulling a tail hurts the cat. Keep gentle hands and listen to your grown-up.
Your grown-up says the flowers need water. Which choice helps?
Help water the flowers
Helping water the flowers gives them a drink. Our pretend garden grows!
Pull out the flowers
Pulling out the flowers damages them. Try helping your grown-up water them.
Your snack wrapper is left on the picnic blanket. Which choice helps?
Put my wrapper in the bin
Putting your wrapper in the bin helps keep the picnic place clean. Our pretend garden grows!
Drop it on the grass
Dropping the wrapper leaves litter behind. Try using the bin.
You see a tiny snail beside the garden path. Which choice helps?
Watch and give it space
Watching gently gives the little snail space to move. Our pretend garden grows!
Poke the snail
Poking can hurt a tiny animal. Try watching without touching.
Your friend drops some crayons on the floor. Which choice helps?
Offer to help pick them up
Offering help makes picking up easier for your friend. Our pretend garden grows!
Kick them farther away
Kicking the crayons away makes more work. Try offering to help pick them up.
Your friend is telling you about their toy. Which choice helps?
Listen for my turn to talk
Listening gives your friend a turn to share their story. Our pretend garden grows!
Shout over their words
Shouting over your friend makes it hard to hear them. Try listening for your turn.
Your teddy is ready for a pretend nap. Which choice helps?
Make a cozy spot
Making a cozy spot is a caring way to play with your teddy. Our pretend garden grows!
Throw teddy across the room
Throwing teddy across the room could hit someone. Try making a cozy resting spot.
Your friend is using a paintbrush you would like to borrow. Which choice helps?
Ask to use it next
Asking to use it next respects your friend's turn. Our pretend garden grows!
Snatch the paintbrush
Snatching interrupts your friend's painting. Try asking for the next turn.
